$description: Tooltip component tokens. The tooltip surface is a neutral inverse surface (dark in light mode, light in dark mode) — intentionally decoupled from the brand fill so re-theming primary buttons leaves tooltips untouched. The text color is auto-derived from this background's luminance by the element, so only the background is exposed.

background-color.$description: Tooltip surface color — dark in light mode, light in dark mode. Neutral by design; not tied to --l-color-bg-fill-brand, so changing the brand color does not recolor tooltips. Override globally to re-skin every tooltip, or use the per-instance --background-color custom property on a single `<l-tooltip>`.
